function: The text-overflow property specifies how overflowed content that is not displayed should be signaled to the user. It can be clipped, display an ellipsis (...), or display a custom string.

values.function: Default value. The text is clipped and not accessible
Render an ellipsis ("...") to represent the clipped text
Render the given string to represent the clipped text
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
Inherits this property from its parent element. Read about inherit
